skills.name: to-spec
skills.summary: Synthesize the current conversation into a spec and publish it to the issue tracker.

skills.name: to-tickets
skills.summary: Break a spec or plan into tracer-bullet tickets that declare their blocking edges.

skills.name: prototype
skills.summary: Answer a design question with throwaway code: divergent UI variants behind a live picker, or candidate logic models run through scenarios with a recommendation.

skills.name: implement
skills.summary: Implement a ticket or spec through `implementation-proof`, asking any open question once up front, then commit.

skills.name: implement-spec
skills.summary: Implement a whole spec from its ticket graph on one integration branch, a fresh implementer per ticket following `implementation-proof`, ready to file as one PR or a short stack.

skills.name: tdd
skills.summary: Build test-first in red-green slices at agreed seams, with a reference on what makes a test worth keeping.

skills.name: jira-acli
skills.summary: Read, plan, and update Jira work items through Atlassian ACLI, with Markdown conversion, backups, and verified description and link writes. Requires local Jira authentication and explicit write intent.

skills.name: comment-audit
skills.summary: Review relevant comments and report a table of recommended actions. Request edits to apply them, as `implementation-proof` does before code review.

skills.name: code-review
skills.summary: Review implementation changes against project standards and the spec, including callers outside the diff.

skills.name: babysit-pr
skills.summary: Monitor CI and review bots, address findings, and stop within a bounded review budget.

skills.name: file-pr
skills.summary: Review the branch diff, reuse or open a PR and attach warranted UI evidence. Without a repository template, the body leads with a summary and UI evidence, then merge danger, verification and decisions.

skills.name: full-send
skills.summary: Implement an issue or spec through `implementation-proof`, then prove, file, babysit and merge.

skills.name: full-stop
skills.summary: Implement an issue or spec through `implementation-proof`, then prove, file and babysit, leaving the PR ready for you to merge.

skills.name: leaving-pr-comments
skills.summary: Write and verify evidence-backed GitHub comments and review replies.

skills.name: sol-loop
skills.summary: Run bounded independent code review with Sol through explicit T3 or native reviewer routes.

skills.name: flow-walk
skills.summary: For a new or reshaped user flow, hand one user goal to a fresh tester before code review, and sort its report on friction, copy weight and hierarchy.

skills.name: uat
skills.summary: Test acceptance criteria and explore user workflows with agent-browser, retaining reproducible findings and responsive checks.

skills.name: ui-evidence
skills.summary: Capture, prepare, annotate, compare, and publish UI screenshots and video into a pull request or issue.

skills.name: generated-image-assets
skills.summary: Remove an image's background, verify the alpha edges, and size it for shipping.

categories.title: Shared methods
categories.intro: A shared method holds a discipline that several skills follow, so the rule lives in one place. You don't invoke one yourself: install it alongside the skills that name it.

skills.name: implementation-proof
skills.summary: The method behind `implement`, `implement-spec`, `full-send` and `full-stop`: state what the work must prove, build it test-first, check it running when the change calls for it, then audit comments and review.
